about.en: PAPER is the native token of Papertrade, an on-chain synthetic perpetuals exchange on Hyperliquid with one-click high-leverage trading against a self-bootstrapping liquidity pool. Staked PAPER earns a share of protocol revenue, and new PAPER is minted to traders on losing closes and liquidations. It is the HyperEVM token 0xe40f17915daa230324030003a197cdaef2261c0e.
